commands.name: mhdlg.get_mhdlgcap_supported_trays
commands.purpose: Enumerate supported paper input trays and their numeric IDs.
commands.review_evidence: MHDLG consumer slot4 is interface SUID0x1154a in A0518754..A051876C. PE provider table A05CC93C has matching SUID, slot1; interface getter A0305068 returns initialized object A05CC04C from20848514. Object points to vtable20848770. Relevant methods +8/+10/+60/+64/+6C/+EC resolve to A0303E9C/A0303EBA/A030408C/A030409A/A03040B0/A030437A. A0062F7A uses +10 -> A0303EBA -> A030DC0C, a bounded ROM table traversal. ROM A05CFBB0 has1 record, ID1, so count fits14slots. A006345E formats count and name/ID using A02541FC.
commands.side_effects_assessment: Reads initialized metadata, writes caller buffers and formats UART output.
commands.result_limitations: Finite capability metadata. No tray activation or paper movement.

commands.name: mhdlg.get_mhdlgcap_media_type_size_list
commands.purpose: Enumerate media sizes for verified tray1.
commands.review_evidence: MHDLG consumer slot4 is interface SUID0x1154a in A0518754..A051876C. PE provider table A05CC93C has matching SUID, slot1; interface getter A0305068 returns initialized object A05CC04C from20848514. Object points to vtable20848770. Relevant methods +8/+10/+60/+64/+6C/+EC resolve to A0303E9C/A0303EBA/A030408C/A030409A/A03040B0/A030437A. First parsed integer0 selects sizes,1 selects types; second is trayID. A00630A4 routes sizes through +8 -> A030DADE and types through +60 -> A030E04C. Both deduplicate bounded ROM arrays into caller buffers; tray1 table has32 sizes and4 types. Handler prints symbolic and numeric identifiers.
commands.side_effects_assessment: Reads initialized metadata, writes caller buffers and formats UART output.
commands.result_limitations: The two selectors share one registered command name and count as one name.

commands.name: mhdlg.get_supported_df_groups
commands.purpose: Determine whether the firmware exposes additional media feed groups.
commands.review_evidence: MHDLG consumer slot4 is interface SUID0x1154a in A0518754..A051876C. PE provider table A05CC93C has matching SUID, slot1; interface getter A0305068 returns initialized object A05CC04C from20848514. Object points to vtable20848770. Relevant methods +8/+10/+60/+64/+6C/+EC resolve to A0303E9C/A0303EBA/A030408C/A030409A/A03040B0/A030437A. A0063212 calls +64 -> A030409A -> A030E0BA. It reads group count from ROM A05CFBB8 (0 in this image), writes only bounded caller array, and returns status200 pluscount0. A0063896 outputs both status and count.
commands.side_effects_assessment: Reads initialized metadata, writes caller buffers and formats UART output.
commands.result_limitations: A successful zero-count capability result is expected, not a media-motion test.
